verdict.rationale: Okta documents Cross App Access (XAA) for agent-to-app connections using OIDC, plus a free end-to-end playground. It frames XAA as a way to let AI apps act for users without exposing credentials or losing admin control, which covers the cross-app-access element. The other elements of the story are absent or only implied: there is no token vaulting, no explicit scoped agent credentials, and no evidence that agents are managed as first-class identities. The XAA material is also blog posts rather than reference docs. missing for 10: token vaulting, documented scoped agent credentials, agents as first-class directory identities, in-depth reference docs beyond blog posts, independent or hands-on corroboration of XAA.
